name: A level-60 leader with open world scaling off does not stop a Dungeon Finder group's dungeon from scaling
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with the default
DestinyWeaver.Scaling.DungeonIds. While grouped, the leader's Destiny Weaver switch is every member's open world
scaling switch. A scaled five-player dungeon does not consult it for a Dungeon Finder group: Ascension scales a
finder run to each character in it, so a level-60 leader with the switch off must not hold a level-26 member to
Maraudon's authored level-45 creatures. Maraudon is finder entry 26; walking in keeps the authored creatures
(#11184). Maraudon (map 349) holds its band from LFGDungeons.dbc TargetLevelMin 20; the member, whose own switch
is on but who follows the leader's off switch while grouped, still sees a level-45 Black Riding Wolf 5194 at 26.

steps.label: The group is a Dungeon Finder group assigned Maraudon
Let the group's switch reach the member
DISCRIMINATING: the member sees the Maraudon creature at their own level
The member's client is sent level 26
